title: A Rough Instantaneous Squared VIX Model for Term Structure and Option Pricing
abstract: arXiv:2611.07120v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The VIX term structure provides forward-looking measures of market uncertainty across horizons, while VIX options allow investors to hedge volatility risk. This paper proposes a rough instantaneous squared VIX (RISVIX) model by introducing fractional memory into the conventional Markovian framework. We derive an explicit representation of the VIX term structure governed by Mittag--Leffler decay and a semi-closed-form pricing formula for VIX options based on an affine Fourier--Laplace transform. These results support a two-step calibration procedure that estimates memory, mean reversion, and date-specific initial states from VIX term-structure indices before calibrating the remaining distributional parameters to VIX option prices. Using daily VIX term-structure indices and VIX option quotes from January 2018 to June 2025, we find that RISVIX improves upon the Markovian benchmark in fitting the VIX term structure, with larger gains during

translated_title: 用于期限结构与期权定价的粗糙瞬时平方VIX模型
translated_abstract: VIX期限结构提供了跨期限的市场不确定性前瞻性度量，而VIX期权则使投资者能够对冲波动率风险。本文通过在传统马尔可夫框架中引入分数阶记忆，提出了一种粗糙瞬时平方VIX（RISVIX）模型。我们推导出了由Mittag–Leffler衰减所刻画的VIX期限结构的显式表示，以及基于仿射Fourier–Laplace变换的VIX期权半闭式定价公式。这些结果支持一个两步校准程序：先从VIX期限结构指数中估计记忆参数、均值回复参数以及特定日期的初始状态，然后再将其余分布参数校准至VIX期权价格。利用2018年1月至2025年6月的每日VIX期限结构指数和VIX期权报价，我们发现RISVIX在拟合VIX期限结构方面优于马尔可夫基准模型，且改善在（市场动荡）期间更为显著。
tldr: 本文提出将分数阶记忆引入传统马尔可夫框架的粗糙瞬时平方VIX（RISVIX）模型，推导出Mittag–Leffler衰减形式的VIX期限结构显式表示和基于仿射Fourier–Laplace变换的VIX期权半闭式定价公式，并通过两步校准方法在实证中显著优于马尔可夫基准模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a rough instantaneous squared VIX (RISVIX) model that introduces fractional memory into the Markovian framework, deriving an explicit Mittag–Leffler-based representation of the VIX term structure and a semi-closed-form VIX option pricing formula via an affine Fourier–Laplace transform, with a two-step calibration that empirically outperforms the Markovian benchmark.
